name: Judicator Prime Task Group
role: Standing Galactic Union task group centered on the Judicator Prime, combining flagship command, two medium destroyer-class escorts, and one fuel/supply bulker.

command_model.task_group_authority: Captain Alric Tann directs formation movement, coordinated defense, task-group priorities, and naval operations through the Judicator's flag-command role.
command_model.ship_command_boundary: Each accompanying captain retains internal command, discipline, readiness, safety, and damage-control authority aboard their own vessel.
command_model.hosted_asset_boundary: Rangers, Marshals, Sentinels, the Field Court, and other institutionally distinct hosted assets remain governed by JUDICATOR-HOST-001 and are not converted into ordinary task-group ship's companies.
command_model.logistics_boundary: The bulker's professional logistics chain controls cargo safety, transfer feasibility, contamination control, and honest readiness reporting.

normal_roles: fuel, stores, parts, ordnance, and fabrication-feedstock replenishment
sustained support for Marshal, judicial, diplomatic, humanitarian, and naval operations
formation_rule: Standing composition defines normal assignment, not mandatory co-location at every moment. Escorts and bulker may be detached, replaced, delayed, or separated by combat, replenishment, rescue, or emergency movement, with positions recorded per event.

existing_class_nonassignment.cls_obsidian: Not assigned by implication; canonical stealth-destroyer role is narrower than the current generic medium-destroyer slots.
existing_class_nonassignment.cls_reliant: Plausible logistics lineage but not assigned by implication to the fuel/supply bulker slot.

notes: Composition is owner-locked CANON. No ghost vessel IDs were created: the three external-vessel identities, exact classes, captains, and technical specifications remain open for a coordinated minting pass.
